title: Ring tensor cohomology functors and canonical comparison
statement: Let $R\to A$ and $R\to B$ be maps of commutative rings. Write $\mathrm{CoCh}(A)$ for the category of cochain complexes of $A$-modules [def-pc-cochain-complex-modules]. Choose functorial K-flat resolutions $F_R\to\mathrm{id}$ and $F_A\to\mathrm{id}$ on $\mathrm{CoCh}(R)$ and $\mathrm{CoCh}(A)$ (functors preserving zero morphisms whose values are K-flat, with augmentations quasi-isomorphisms), and let $U:\mathrm{CoCh}(A)\to\mathrm{CoCh}(R)$ be restriction of scalars. Define $L_B(M)=B\otimes_R F_R(UM)$ and $T_B(M)=B\otimes_R U(F_A M)$ by termwise base change [def-weil-module-base-change], with $B$ acting on the first factor. For $i\in\mathbb Z$ define the functors $H_L^i(B)(M)=H^i(L_B(M))$ and $H_T^i(B)(M)=H^i(T_B(M))$ to $B$-modules. The second is the usual model for $M\otimes_A^{\mathbf L}(A\otimes_R B)$, via $B\otimes_R P\cong P\otimes_A(A\otimes_R B)$. Set $V_B(M)=B\otimes_R F_R(UF_A M)$. The augmentations give $V_B(M)\to L_B(M)$ and $V_B(M)\to T_B(M)$; the former is a quasi-isomorphism. Define the canonical comparison $c_B^i:H_L^i(B)\to H_T^i(B)$ as the inverse on cohomology of the first arrow followed by cohomology of the second. The $A$-actions are induced by the chain endomorphisms $a\operatorname{id}_M$; the $B$-actions are those on the tensor factor. For a compatible flat map $B\to C$ [def-weil-pbc-flat-ring-map], define, for every $R$-complex $K$, $b_K^i:C\otimes_B H^i(B\otimes_R K)\to H^i(C\otimes_R K)$ as the inverse of the exact-functor homology isomorphism followed by the homology of the associativity isomorphism $C\otimes_B(B\otimes_R K)\cong C\otimes_R K$. Here the left-sided tensor convention is identified with the right-sided convention by tensor symmetry.

proof.text: The augmentation of the chosen A-resolution is a quasi-isomorphism. Exact restriction of scalars preserves it. Naturality of the R-resolution augmentation and quasiIso_iff_comp_right show that resolving this restricted map gives a quasi-isomorphism; both its endpoints are K-flat by LeftResolution.kFlat_resolutionFunctor_obj.

Apply the existing proved helper CochainComplex.scalarExtension_quasiIso_of_kFlat from KFlatScalarExtensionDerivedIso (accessible with a proof-only import all). It sends the resolved restricted augmentation, a quasi-isomorphism between K-flat R-complexes, to a quasi-isomorphism after termwise extension to B. This uses the map-specific scalar-extension part of the cited module, not its existence of an unspecified homology equivalence.

For every A-complex M the left span component is exactly this scalar-extended map. Its homology map in every integer degree is invertible. NatTrans.isIso_iff_isIso_app gives invertibility of the homology natural transformation, permitting the unchanged comparison definition. All other constructions remain unchanged.
